'''Max Walter Reis''' ({{Langx|he|מקס רייס}}; 1927-2014) was a [[chemical engineer]] who was President of the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology]] from 1986–1990.<ref>{{cite web |title=MAX REIS |url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/nytimes/name/max-reis-obituary?pid=172655287 |publisher=New York Times |access-date=11 September 2021}}</ref>

==Biography==
Reis attended [[Imperial College London]], where he obtained a PhD. in [[chemical engineering]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/16251756|title=Max W Reis; Former Board Member, B Gaon Holdings Ltd|website=Bloomberg}}</ref><ref>[https://s24.q4cdn.com/720828402/files/doc_downloads/shareholder_meetings/previous_years/Teva2007AGMProxy.pdf "TEVA PHARMACEUTICAL INDUSTRIES LIMITED"]</ref><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ISRbAAAAIAAJ&q=Max+Reis+%22Technion%22|title=Who's who in Israel and in the work for Israel abroad|date=1978|publisher=Bronfman & Cohen Publications}}</ref> Reis was President of the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology]] from 1986–1990.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.technion.ac.il/en/former-presidents/ |title="Technion President; Former Presidents" |access-date=2020-01-28 |archive-date=2019-07-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190704050200/https://www.technion.ac.il/en/former-presidents/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
